groups.saying_opens: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يرتفق

notes: Two sayings with their own isnads (owner ruling 6): the curtain report and the cushions report, each group labelled with its saying
«يقال له ربيعة بن عطاء» is scene, but his own «أنا سمعت» makes him a link (rule 5); «أبا محمد» is written as the text gives it, the gloss «- يعني القاسم -» left out
